name: Demo H2: Delete-Like Redline Tag
description: Exercise a delete-like redline operation using a disposable tag target: create a bounded tag, prove it is visible, dry-run delete, apply delete, and verify it is absent afterward.
setup_instructions: Open a disposable Revit model or a model that can be closed without saving.
Use a view that supports tagging the configured element id.
Use a taggable target element in the same view so repeated live runs create and delete only disposable tag elements.
success_criteria: A disposable tag id is created in the requested view for the requested target element.
The created tag id is visible in the pre-delete visible-element inventory.
The /revit/delete dry-run returns effect evidence covering the created tag id.
The applied /revit/delete response returns effect evidence covering the created tag id.
The post-delete visible-element inventory no longer contains the created tag id.
A deterministic delete visual gate artifact passes using before/after capture evidence.
failure_criteria: The tag target is not created or is created in the wrong view.
The delete dry-run only echoes requested ids and does not return effect evidence.
The applied delete response omits the tag id from effect evidence.
The tag is still visible after delete.
The delete visual gate artifact is missing or fails.
grader_notes: This task is the first non-text add/delete redline benchmark and intentionally creates a disposable tag before deleting it.
Do not count requestedIds-only delete responses as evidence; dry-run and apply must return ids, deletedIds, or impactedIds.
